parameters.title: The row's words.
parameters.subtitle: A second line under title.
parameters.leading: A glyph at the start, 24 px.
parameters.trailing: Places a widget at the trailing edge.
parameters.trailingText: A value at the end, in the muted ink.
parameters.onTap: Runs when the reader activates the component. Leave it unset for a read-only item.
parameters.selected: Whether the row stands chosen, filled with ink.
parameters.showChevron: Controls the directional indicator at the end of the row.
parameters.isDestructiveAction: Applies the destructive treatment to the row.
parameters.enabled: Controls whether the row accepts input.
parameters.semanticLabel: What a screen reader calls it when title is not the right name.
